description.en: Curated collection of copy-paste UI sound effects and audio hooks for the web.
description.zh: 为现代 Web 界面量身定制的即拷即用 UI 交互音效与音频反馈钩子库。

content.en: soundcn brings tactile acoustic feedback to modern web applications. Modeled after the shadcn distribution model, it provides zero-latency sound effects for clicks, notifications, toggles, success states, and tab transitions, accompanied by lightweight React audio hooks.
content.zh: soundcn 借鉴了 shadcn 的现代组件分发模式，将细腻的声学交互反馈引入现代 Web 界面。全库收录数十款精心调校的轻量级零延迟音效（包括轻触按键声、清脆拨动开关、成功提示与卡片抽拉声），并提供简单优雅的 React Web Audio Hook。
